He mainly plays the [[shooting guard]] position. ==Professional career== ===Early years=== Korkmaz was born in [[Bakırköy]], [[Istanbul]]. He started playing basketball with the school team when he was nine. In 2012, he moved to the [[Anadolu Efes S.K.|Anadolu Efes]] junior team from Yeşilyurt Spor Kulübü for $250,000 at age of 15. ===Anadolu Efes=== In the first year, he played for the junior and youth teams of Efes. He was loaned for the 2013–14 season to [[Turkish Basketball Second League|TB2L]] team [[Pertevniyal S.K.|Pertevniyal]] which is the pilot club of Anadolu Efes. In the summer of 2014, Korkmaz moved to [[Anadolu Efes S.K.|Anadolu Efes]] first team. On June 13, 2016, Korkmaz was one of 13 different international underclassmen to enter the [[2016 NBA Draft]]. Furthermore, because of his declaration earlier in May that he'd only enter the draft if he were guaranteed to be drafted somewhere in the middle of the draft, it's been said that Korkmaz will be
